what: Two speed-of-light gaps left open in blaze-build-script (docs/v2/plan/lanes/usercode/speed-of-light.md, "What is left in blaze-build-script"). (1) elide/lex.rs at about 3.3n cycles against 1.0n: a std::simd stage 1 (64 bytes a step into masks of identifier bytes, spaces, quotes, \r and 0xE2) and a lexer at about 10 instructions a token, with a differential test against elide/lex/tests/reference.rs over seeded inputs and the corpus. (2) env.rs merged(): about 15% over from sorting the whole of what cargo sets. Make the fixed names slots indexed by a const sorted table at each cmd.set call so only [env], features, cfgs and DEP_* are sorted before one merge, keeping last-word-wins (seq) and remove(), with a test against env/tests/reference.rs.
